name: Scrolling Position
author: jvz
description: Where you are on the tape: column position indicator for Hyprland's scrolling layout.

barWidget.description: Minimap of the scrolling layout's column tape, with the on-screen viewport marked. Click to switch between the proportional map and plain pips.

schema.label: Display mode
schema.description: map = column widths drawn to scale with a viewport bracket; pips = one dot per column. Clicking the widget switches modes and saves the choice here.

schema.label: Map length in pixels
schema.description: Length of the minimap along the bar. Ignored in pips mode.

schema.label: Heartbeat interval (ms)
schema.description: Fallback refresh for scrolls that emit no Hyprland event. 0 disables it (event-driven only).

schema.label: Hide when the workspace has one column
schema.description: Nothing to scroll to, so the indicator can get out of the way.
